programme_facts.value: According to the Collegedunia Rankings 2026, the top 5 Medical Colleges in Pune for MBBS.
Symbiosis Medical College for Women (SMCW), Pune, is the only MBBS college in Pune exclusively for women.

BJMC Pune, AFMC Pune, SKNMCGH Pune, and MIMER Pune are affiliated with the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS), Nashik. SMCW Pune and SIU Pune come under Symbiosis International (Deemed University), BVMC Pune under Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed University), and DYPMC Pune under Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth (DPU), Pune.

The internship stipend at Medical Colleges in Pune is INR 18,000 per month as per Maharashtra Government norms, applicable to government colleges from February 2024, directed by the DMER to private colleges as well. AFMC Pune interns receive INR 60,000 – 75,000 per month as per the 7th CPC norms.
